method: Preferred stock of periods whose preferred dividends exceed 0.2% of equity while companyfacts has no positive preferred value of which the dividends are at most 25%. Each value is the balance at the period end of the one column of the statement of changes in equity whose StatementEquityComponentsAxis member names preferred stock, in the original XBRL instance of the first annual report of the period, with no other dimension. Periods without such a positive balance are listed with the reason.
